"""A generated SQLite-backed command-line task manager."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse

from database import add_task, complete_task, initialize, list_tasks


def show_tasks() -> None:
    tasks = list_tasks()
    if not tasks:
        print('No tasks yet.')
        return
    print('ID  STATUS  TITLE')
    print('--  ------  -----')
    for task_id, title, completed in tasks:
        status = 'done' if completed else 'open'
        print(f'{task_id:<3} {status:<7} {title}')


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='SQLite Task Manager')
    subcommands = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', required=True)
    subcommands.add_parser('init', help='Initialize the task database')
    add_parser = subcommands.add_parser('add', help='Add a task')
    add_parser.add_argument('title')
    subcommands.add_parser('list', help='List tasks')
    complete_parser = subcommands.add_parser('complete', help='Complete a task')
    complete_parser.add_argument('task_id', type=int)
    arguments = parser.parse_args()

    if arguments.command == 'init':
        initialize()
        print('SQLite task database initialized.')
    elif arguments.command == 'add':
        initialize()
        task_id = add_task(arguments.title)
        print(f'ID: {task_id} created')
    elif arguments.command == 'list':
        initialize()
        show_tasks()
    elif arguments.command == 'complete':
        initialize()
        if complete_task(arguments.task_id):
            print(f'ID: {arguments.task_id} completed')
        else:
            print(f'No task found for ID: {arguments.task_id}')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
